label: prf:spin-labels
title: Proof of spin labels
html:
Because G = \mathrm{Aut}^{\otimes}(\tau) \cong \mathrm{SU}(2) (\mathrm{SU}(2) emergence), the simple objects of \mathbf{C} are indexed by a spin label j \in \{0, \tfrac12, 1, \tfrac32, \ldots\}, with V_j denoting the simple object of categorical dimension 2j + 1.

The symplectic form \epsilon \colon \Lambda^2 V \to \mathbf{1} (quantum observable universe, axiom (iii)) is the unique (up to scalar) G-invariant alternating pairing on V.
